components.name: Empty Circle for Letter
components.description: A plain circular enclosure. Exclude the capital N and its diagonal extension.

components.name: Existing N Glyph Layout
components.description: Reuse the preferred existing `letter-n-uppercase` glyph for exact text `N` using its stored paths and metrics from icon_set/typeface/glyphs.json. Center the existing capital N within the separately briefed circle; preserve the source’s diagonal extension as layout evidence for review, without inventing altered glyph geometry. Exclude all surrounding objects; do not trace or invent a replacement character.
